verdict.reasoning: The diff makes core.hooksPath point to a content-addressed user-level directory shared across repositories, so any additional hook written there is necessarily visible to every repository using that content ID. It also migrates or uninstalls a pre-#173 directory by calling RemoveAll after ownership is established only through legacyHooksAreOurs, which checks the metareview pre-push hook; unrelated additional hooks in that directory are therefore deleted. This causes setup to report a conflict and uninstall not to unset its own prior installation.
